description: Unchanged original durable-write tests against fresh test-owned temporary directories on macOS. No personal state.
isolationRationale: Coordinator fully read the test and five runtime modules including win32-utils re-export. Imports are relative within this closure or Node builtins/vitest. Functions perform filesystem I/O only at paths supplied by these tests, all fresh mkdtemp directories; test cleanup removes only its own directory. Windows command/ACL functions exist in imported win32-utils but are not invoked by these macOS test paths. No top-level subprocess or personal-profile access. No modifications to assertions/mocks. Not a security sandbox.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Original installed Vitest4.1.11, Node24.19.0, node environment. No install. Minimal config omits source aliases, setup files, feature-wall define, GC/webstorage and platform worker settings. This closure does not use them; no full-config equivalence claim.
Default unit timeouts replace root30s/60s test/hook limits; outer command30s. Only macOS execution, not Windows/Linux acceptance.
testEvidenceBoundary: Six direct it bodies loop over async/sync modes (12), plus one sequential last-writer case. Atomicity is a test title, not a crash/concurrency proof. Multi-MB test checks string length, UTF8 test exact string. Does not test real power loss.
